% ===== 全局排版：行距/表格/图片/断行（M10 排版精修）=====
\usepackage{setspace}
\setstretch{1.15}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.18}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}

\clubpenalty=4000
\widowpenalty=4000
\RequirePackage{graphicx}
\setkeys{Gin}{width=\textwidth,keepaspectratio}

% 长表格用 \small 字体，减少列溢出
